description.p: Manu is an AI-native fiction development environment. A project is a folder of plain files you own; the story's structure — state, knowledge, relationships, chronology, objects, threads and causality — is recorded alongside the manuscript so continuity can be checked, tested, debugged and refactored deterministically.

Every deterministic check runs with no model configured at all. When a model is configured it proposes rather than writes: nothing reaches the manuscript without the author accepting it, and every change is recorded and revertible.
